description: The pie chart, titled "Narrative Media Framing in Political Discourse," displays the distribution of media framing across four categories, with each slice labeled with its corresponding percentage and a numerical value in parentheses. The largest segment, colored blue, represents "Right bias" and accounts for 30.0% (30) of the total. The second largest segment, orange, corresponds to "Left bias" and makes up 28.0% (28). The green segment, labeled "Questionable source," represents 22.0% (22), and the red segment, labeled "Right bias," accounts for 20.0% (20). The chart includes a legend positioned to the right of the pie, which matches the colors to their respective labels. The slices are arranged in a clockwise direction starting from the top right, and the percentages are clearly labeled within each segment. The chart does not show any visually emphasized or exploded slices.
